messages:
marcus: heads-up, we're seeing sustained p95/queueing up in hosted-usw2-gpu pool since ~08:10 UTC. dashboards showing slot utilization ~98% but admission errors rising.
ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-usw2-gpu-pool headroom < 5% for 12m — p95 queueing latency 2.3s, admission_rejects 0.8% :rotating_light:
anya: noticing a bunch of short-lived embedding jobs from project 'search-embed' spiking. they create many tiny allocations that don't batch well — could be causing slot bleed.
jin: can we confirm if it's real slot usage or fragmentation? query i ran: 
```
sum by(pool) (gpu_slots_in_use{pool="hosted-usw2"})
sum by(pool) (gpu_slots_total{pool="hosted-usw2"})
```
marcus: fragmentation metric (slot_fragmentation_ratio) is up to 0.42 vs baseline 0.12. looks like slot exhaustion without actual GPU saturation.
lia: also seeing elevated client retries in the proxy logs (x-retries header) — retried requests inflate apparent concurrency. snippet: `proxy: 500->502 retried=3 path=/v1/generate`
anya: possible root cause: many tiny requests with high concurrency + aggressive client retry/backoff not respected by admission controller. admission estimates use avg duration; short bursts cause mis-estimate.
jin: quick mitigation: enable soft-throttle on that project (rate-limit to 60% of prior commit) and temporarily increase batch window to 40ms for embeddings to let requests batch. thoughts?
marcus: agree. also toggle the fragmentation-recompact job to run now on pool7 to defragment slot allocation. I'll kick it off.
ops-bot: deploybot: triggered run: slot-recompact job -> pool7 (hosted-usw2). started 1749998802.
lia: putting a temporary routing rule to divert overflow to eu-west1 spare capacity for non-PII traffic. config: `route_policy: overflow_to=hosted-euw1 if headroom<10% and traffic_tag!=pii`
anya: can we add a short-term cost note? diverting will add egress + cross-region overhead. estimate ~+$1.2k/day if maintained.
marcus: noted. triage plan: (1) soft-throttle 'search-embed' 60% (anya), (2) slot-recompact pool7 (marcus), (3) bump batch window for embeddings (jin), (4) reroute non-PII overflow to euw (lia), (5) monitor for 30m and reassess. I'll own follow-up.
jin: monitor query I'll watch: `rate(admission_rejects_total[1m])`, `slot_fragmentation_ratio`, `proxy_retries_total`. posting graph link: https://dash.internal.redwood/p/abc123/hosted-usw2-saturation
anya: deploying throttle now. done 1749998833 :thumbsup:
marcus: recompact job succeeded 1749998845, freed ~9% slots. immediate p95 dropped to 1.1s. keep actions running for 30m.
lia: routing change applied 1749998870.
ops-bot: [INFO] monitor-check scheduled in 15m to verify headroom > 15% or alert escalation.
marcus: thanks team. postmortem if this persists, otherwise note as operational tweak and follow up with platform policy on short-lived-client guidance.
anya: filing a short doc with client best-practices and recommended retry/backoff patterns. will link here when ready.
